When Safe Mode is ON, Pikura: ① forces sequential downloads (concurrency 1), ② enforces a 2–4 second jittered delay between artworks even if your delay is 0, and ③ honors Retry-After headers on HTTP 429/503 with exponential backoff (5→10→20→60s, ±25% jitter) without consuming your retry budget. Disable only for small, occasional jobs.
